lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×30

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I got the footage you sent me.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I'm loving what I see.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I'm sure we'll be able to put it to good use.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: One second, I have another call coming in.
For a while, there was no response.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: You're close to the CEO of Elysion?

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Let's pretend that none of this ever happened.
What are you planning to do with that video?

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Doesn't matter. I'm calling the whole thing off. There's no reason for the video to be used.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Let's end the conversation here.
Answer my question.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I just wanted to add a little spice to the mix.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I was going to depict a ravaged Ark that had been decimated by the Nikkes.
Do you think people would believe that it's real?

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: It may sound hard to believe,

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: but I'm sure there are some people who would believe it.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: For those kinds of people, their feelings are more important than the truth.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I make money by playing to those feelings.
Don't ever contact me again.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I won't.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: The last thing I want to do is get tangled up with someone who knows a CEO.
Tetra Connect has left the chat room.
